rice.content: Use certified seeds or farm-saved seeds with more than 70% germination.
Perform salt treatment using 300 g salt per 10 L water, discard floaters, wash, dry, and treat seeds with fungicide and Trichoderma @ 4-5 g/kg seed.
Direct sowing is recommended from the 2nd week of June to 10 July.
Transplant seedlings between 2 July and 20 July.
Perform deep ploughing with sub-soiler, align cultivation parallel to slope, dig farm ponds, and prepare land for drill sowing.
Apply Pendimethalin 30% EC @ 50 ml/10 L water as pre-emergence herbicide after sowing.
Apply Bispyribac sodium 10% SC @ 6-7 ml/10 L water 10-15 days after sowing.
Apply 100:50:50 kg NPK/ha with full phosphorus and potassium and half nitrogen at planting.
Apply split dose of remaining nitrogen during tillering stage.
Apply remaining nitrogen during panicle initiation stage.

maize.content: Sow maize from mid-June to first week of July using PDKV Arambha variety.
Apply 20-25 cartloads of FYM per hectare before sowing.
Treat maize seeds with biofertilizer @ 25 g/kg seed.
Apply 120:60:60 NPK in three splits with 1/3 at sowing.
Apply second split of fertilizer at 30 DAS.
Apply third split of fertilizer at 50 DAS.
Maintain clean cultivation with deep ploughing, trap crops like Napier grass, bird perches, and pheromone traps.
Spray 5% NSKE and release Trichogramma @ 50,000 per acre weekly.
Treat seeds with Cyantraniliprole + Thiamethoxam for Fall Armyworm management.
Apply Emamectin or NPV sprays if Fall Armyworm infestation occurs.

cotton.content: Sow cotton during May-June. Irrigated sowing is recommended from 20-30 May, dry sowing in early June, and post-monsoon sowing from 15-30 June.
Perform deep ploughing every three years for rainfed areas and annually for irrigated areas followed by two harrowings and one pre-sowing harrowing.
Apply FYM or compost at 12-15 cartloads for rainfed and 20-25 cartloads or 5 t/ha for irrigated fields with 2.5 t/ha vermicompost if available.
Treat seeds with Imidacloprid or Thiamethoxam (7.5 g/kg), Thiram or Captan (3 g/kg), Azotobacter (25 g/kg), and PSB (20 g/kg).
Maintain spacing of 120 × 90 cm for Bt/Hybrid irrigated cotton and 60 × 15 cm or 60 × 30 cm for rainfed deshi cotton.
Intercrop cotton with green gram, black gram, soybean, sorghum, or pigeon pea.
Carry out gap filling and thinning within 3-5 days after emergence.
Apply recommended NPK doses in split applications depending on irrigated hybrid or rainfed variety.
Apply 2% urea foliar spray during flowering stage.
Apply 2% DAP foliar spray during boll development stage.
Apply 20% fertilizer dose through drip fertigation at 20 DAS.
Apply 25% fertilizer dose through drip fertigation at 40 DAS.
Apply 25% fertilizer dose through drip fertigation at 60 DAS and open furrows for moisture conservation.
Apply remaining 20% fertilizer dose through drip fertigation at 80 DAS.
Maintain weed-free field during first 60 days with 3-4 hoeings and 2-3 weedings.
Provide 2-3 protective irrigations during flowering and bolling in rainfed cotton.
Manage bacterial leaf blight with seed treatment using Carboxin (1 g) and Thiram (3 g/kg).
Control grey mildew using wettable sulphur (25 g/10 L) or Carbendazim (10 g/10 L).
Manage Myrothecium using Copper oxychloride (0.3%), Carbendazim (0.1%), or Mancozeb (0.25%).
Control Alternaria using seed treatment and Mancozeb (0.2%) sprays every 20 days.
Apply drench containing 25 g Copper oxychloride and 150 g urea in 10 L water for Para wilt management.
Intercrop AKH-081 with green gram or black gram and apply recommended NPK doses for improved productivity.
Manage jassid, thrips, aphids, and mites using Dimethoate 30 EC (10 ml/10 L) or Acetamiprid 20 SP (1.5 g/10 L).
Control whiteflies using yellow sticky traps (5 per acre) and Dimethoate 30 EC (33 ml/10 L).
Manage bollworms using Quinalphos, Spinosad, or Cypermethrin.
Control pink bollworm using pheromone traps, Neemark 300 ppm, deep ploughing, and heat treatment.
Install 30 yellow sticky traps and 2-3 light or pheromone traps per gin.
Apply Neem 5%, Verticillium lecanii, and Beauveria bassiana during humid weather conditions.

sugarcane.content: Maintain spacing of 90 cm for rainfed, 120 cm for irrigated or paired row trench planting, and 60 cm for HDPS.
Plant sugarcane in furrows or trenches with buds facing upward and cover lightly with soil.
Apply 250:115:115 NPK kg/ha for irrigated crops and 200:90:90 NPK kg/ha for rainfed crops.
Apply 1/3 nitrogen along with full phosphorus and potassium at planting.
Apply split nitrogen dose at 45 DAP.
Apply remaining nitrogen dose at 90 DAP.
Place fertilizers in bands 8-10 cm deep and 10-15 cm away from rows.
Apply 25-30 t/ha FYM or compost before final harrowing.
Apply Azotobacter and PSB @ 2 kg/ha each mixed with 100 kg compost or FYM during planting.
Intercrop sugarcane with green gram, black gram, soybean, or groundnut during early stages.
Perform light earthing up at 45-60 DAP.
Perform full earthing up at 90-120 DAP.
Apply trash mulching with cane trash after 60 DAP for moisture conservation and weed control.
Plant sugarcane during June-July in well-drained deep loam soils.
Perform deep ploughing followed by two cross harrowings, weed removal, and field leveling with drainage.
Select healthy 9-10 month-old canes and use top two-thirds portion for setts.
Use 45,000-50,000 three-budded setts per hectare with seed rate of 6-8 tonnes.
Treat setts with 0.25% Bavistin or Carbendazim mixed with 2.5% urea solution for 10-15 minutes before planting.
Manage early shoot borer by removing affected shoots, releasing Trichogramma @ 50,000/ha/week, or applying Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 5 ml/L.
Control internode borer using Cartap hydrochloride 4G @ 10 kg/ha or Trichogramma release.
Apply Phorate 10G @ 25 kg/ha in moist soil for white grub management.
Prevent red rot by planting resistant varieties, removing infected clumps, and treating setts with Carbendazim 0.1%.
Control smut using disease-free setts, hot water treatment at 50°C for 30 minutes, or fungicide dips.
Manage wilt through resistant varieties and crop rotation.
Apply 2% urea or 2% DAP during tillering stage if crop appears pale or yellow.
Apply 2% urea or 2% DAP during grand growth stage if crop appears pale or yellow.

soybean.content: Sow soybean between 20th June and 5th July with seed rate of 65 kg/ha and spacing of 45 cm.
Treat seeds with Azoxystrobin @ 10 ml/kg and inoculate with Rhizobium and PSM @ 5 g/kg.
Apply Pendimethalin 30% EC @ 3.25 L/ha or Flumioxazin 50SC @ 250 ml/ha as pre-emergence herbicide.
Apply Imazethapyr 10% SL @ 1 L/ha at 15-20 DAS for post-emergence weed control.
Install sticky traps for whitefly monitoring and manually remove hairy caterpillars if detected.
Apply Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 1 L/ha as first spray for Spodoptera management.
Apply fungicides at first appearance of bacterial and fungal spots.
Apply fertilizers based on 25:60:40:20 NPKS kg/ha using 56 kg urea, 375 kg SSP, and 67 kg MOP.
Treat seeds with Azoxystrobin 2.5%, Thiophanate 11.25%, and Thiamethoxam 25% FS @ 10 ml/kg seed for stem fly, wilt, root rot, and fungal disease management.
Maintain weed-free fields during early growth stage and destroy host plants on bunds.
Remove virus-infected plants promptly to prevent disease spread.
Install 30-40 yellow sticky traps per acre to control whiteflies and sap-sucking pests.
Apply balanced fertilizers and avoid excessive nitrogen to reduce sap-sucking pests and viral spread.
Apply Imidacloprid in 10 L water as required for pest management.
Apply Acetamiprid 25% + Bifenthrin 25% WG @ 5 ml/10 L water for whitefly and yellow viral disease management.

pigeon_pea.content: Sow early pigeon pea varieties during first fortnight of June and medium or late varieties during second fortnight of June.
Maintain row spacing of 45-60 cm for early varieties and 60-75 cm for medium and late varieties.
Use seed rate of 20-25 kg/ha for early varieties and 15-20 kg/ha for medium and late varieties.
Treat seeds with Thiram + Carbendazim or Trichoderma viride along with Rhizobium and PSB culture.
Alternatively treat seeds with Carboxin + Thiram @ 3 g/kg and Trichoderma @ 4 g/kg.
Apply 25-30 kg N, 40-50 kg P2O5, and 30 kg K2O per hectare as basal dose.
Apply 20 kg sulfur and 3 kg zinc per hectare if deficiency symptoms are observed.
Apply Pendimethalin @ 0.75-1 kg a.i./ha as pre-emergence herbicide.
Perform first hand weeding at 20-25 DAS.
Perform second hand weeding at 45-50 DAS.
Provide irrigation during branching stage if dry spell occurs.
Provide irrigation during flowering stage if dry spell occurs.
Provide irrigation during podding stage if dry spell occurs.

mung_bean.content: Sow mung bean from last week of June to first week of July after onset of monsoon.
Treat seeds with Thiamethoxam 70WS @ 5 g/kg for leaf crinkle management.
Spray Thiamethoxam 25WG @ 4 g/10 L at 21 DAS for leaf crinkle management.
Spray Thiamethoxam 25WG @ 4 g/10 L at 35 DAS for leaf crinkle management.
Apply Chitosan spray at 40 ppm during 25 DAS.
Apply Chitosan spray at 40 ppm during 40 DAS.
Spray Metiram + Pyraclostrobin @ 0.3% at first sign of Cercospora infection and repeat after 15 days.
Treat seeds with Trichoderma viride @ 10 g/kg for wilt management.
Spray Fenazaquin @ 1 ml/L at 45 DAS for Sterility Mosaic Disease management.
Spray Fenazaquin @ 1 ml/L at 60 DAS for Sterility Mosaic Disease management.
Apply Emamectin benzoate @ 220 g/ha and install pheromone traps for pod borer management.
Apply NSKE 5% spray at 50% flowering stage for pod fly management.

blackgram.content: Sow black gram from mid-June to early July after onset of monsoon.
Bio-prime seeds with Rhizobium and PSB @ 25 ml/kg for 12 hours before sowing.
Apply 10:20 kg N:P2O5 per hectare for nutrient management.
Spray Monocrotophos @ 12.5 ml/10 L at bud stage for pest management.
Spray Chlorantraniliprole @ 2.5 ml/10 L after 15 days for pest management.

citrus_mandarin.content: Prepare land with four deep ploughings after receipt of early monsoon showers.
Apply hydrated lime @ 500 kg/ha in laterite soils and plough thoroughly.
Plant mandarin during June-July or January-February with spacing of 6 m × 6 m or 5 m × 5 m in lighter soils.
Prepare 1 m3 pits with topsoil, 20-25 kg FYM, 1 kg SSP, and 500 g Neem cake before planting.
Provide light irrigation every 7-10 days for young plants.
Provide irrigation during flowering stage while avoiding over-irrigation.
Provide irrigation during fruit set stage.
Provide irrigation during fruit development stage.
Apply 100 g N, 50 g P, and 50 g K during first year and gradually increase to 500 g N, 250 g P, and 250 g K from fifth year onwards.
Apply split fertilizer dose during June-July.
Apply split fertilizer dose during September-October.
Apply 10-30 kg FYM per tree annually during June.
Intercrop with cowpea, green gram, black gram, or marigold during early years.
Spray Dimethoate or Imidacloprid for citrus psylla and leaf miner management.
Apply Neem oil or Acetamiprid for blackfly and whitefly management.
Use poison bait or bagging for fruit-sucking moth management.
Apply Chlorpyrifos or kerosene for trunk borer management.
Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or Streptocycline 100 ppm + Copper oxychloride 0.2% for canker management.
Scrape bark and apply Metalaxyl paste while ensuring good drainage for gummosis management.
Use disease-free budwood and control psylla vector to prevent greening disease.

turmeric.content: Plant turmeric rhizomes from mid-May to mid-June preferably with onset of monsoon.
Prepare land with four deep ploughings after receipt of early monsoon showers.
Apply hydrated lime @ 500 kg/ha in laterite soils and plough thoroughly.
Prepare beds of 1.0 m width and 15 cm height with spacing of 50 cm between beds.
Treat rhizomes with Mancozeb or Carbendazim before sowing to prevent early diseases.
Apply Trichoderma as bio-fungicide during rhizome treatment.
Maintain spacing of 20-30 cm between plants and 45-60 cm between rows.
Ensure adequate soil moisture during sowing and provide initial irrigation if required.
Apply 25 g powdered neem cake in each pit at planting for pest, nematode, and soil-borne pathogen management.
Apply neem cake @ 2 t/acre during planting.
Perform timely weed control using manual weeding or recommended herbicides.

mango.content: Select well-drained sites and use raised beds if necessary for mango plantation.
Prepare planting pits using topsoil, compost, and 2 kg SSP.
Ensure graft joint remains above soil surface and provide proper staking after planting.
Maintain orchard hygiene and use 10-20% inter-varietal grafting for better cross-pollination.
Dust planting pits with Folidol 2% or Carbaryl 10% @ 100 g per pit before planting.
Use skirting bags in mango for fruit protection.

cashew.content: Plant grafts from improved disease-resistant varieties in pits enriched with compost and 1 kg bone meal or SSP.
Remove polybags carefully during planting to avoid root damage.
Remove pegs or bands after planting to prevent restricted plant growth.

coconut_betel_nut.content: Maintain cleanliness in coconut and betel nut gardens by composting dry leaves and sticks.
Apply 1% Bordeaux mixture as preventive spray for mildew management in betel nut.

gourds.content: Use improved seeds for gourds like padwal and dudhi.
Train gourd vines on trellises for proper growth.

okra.content: Use virus-resistant okra varieties such as Arka Anamika in well-drained soils.

brinjal_chilli.content: Cultivate brinjal and chilli in well-drained soils.
Apply 50 kg nitrogen and 75 kg phosphorus per hectare for brinjal and chilli cultivation.

pepper.content: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture on old pepper vines to control fungal infections.
Ensure proper drainage and provide support for climbing pepper vines.
